description.value: A basic campsite near the remote village of Zeballos at the head of Zeballos Inlet on the wild west coast of Vancouver Island, reached via a 40 km well-maintained gravel road off Highway 19; the area draws kayakers, sport fishers, and nature travellers but specific campground amenities are unconfirmed.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this 'Cevallos Campground,' operated by the Village of Zeballos, with phone +1-250-761-4229 confirmed on the website's contact page as the Village Office general inquiries line. The accommodation page on the website references a 'Zeballos RV Park' operated by the Village of Zeballos described (in truncated text) as a '20 site RV Park – for self-contained units,' which appears to be the same or closely related municipally operated facility under a different name. No campground-specific amenities are described in available website content, and the 'self-contained units' framing raises uncertainty about cyclist/tent suitability.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Cevallos Campground' but the Village of Zeballos website refers to the municipally operated facility as 'Zeballos RV Park' — these may be the same site under different names or two distinct facilities.
Website describes the Village-operated RV Park as 'for self-contained units,' suggesting it may not accommodate tent campers or touring cyclists.
RV Park listing on the website is truncated; full amenity details (electricity, water, etc.) are not available.
No street address provided in the OSM record for this campground.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM name 'Cevallos Campground' does not match the Village of Zeballos website's reference to a municipally operated 'Zeballos RV Park for self-contained units,' creating uncertainty about whether this is the same facility and whether tent camping or cyclist sites are available; on-the-ground verification is needed before listing.
